harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a fresh 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster (node1/node2/node3, RHEL9) holding application data, performed a full maintenance-window shutdown/restart of the entire cluster preserving all committed writes, and separately ran the mandatory one-at-a-time OS reboot protocol on every node with proven boot-identity change and full cluster recovery after each.
actions_performed: Installed mariadb-server, mariadb-server-galera, galera, rsync via dnf on node1/node2/node3
Populated /etc/hosts from CLUSTER_HOSTS and opened firewalld ports 3306/4567(tcp+udp)/4568/4444 with SELinux mysqld_port_t labels on all nodes
Wrote /etc/my.cnf.d/zz-cluster.cnf with wsrep_on=ON and gcomm://node1,node2,node3 on each node (fixed an initial bug where galera.cnf's wsrep_on=0 loaded after and overrode the cluster config)
Bootstrapped Galera on node1 via galera_new_cluster, then joined node2 and node3 sequentially, reaching wsrep_cluster_size=3 / Synced on all nodes
Generated a root DB password on node1, applied via ALTER USER (Galera-replicated cluster-wide), distributed the credential file over the cluster SSH key, verified root login on all three nodes
Created appdata.orders table with 3 committed rows (alice/bob/carol, sum 425.75), verified replication to node2 and node3
Performed the required full maintenance-window shutdown: stopped mariadb on node3, then node2, then node1 in order, confirming node1 alone had safe_to_bootstrap:1 with the highest seqno (10)
Restarted the cluster: bootstrapped node1 (verified 3 rows/sum 425.75 intact), started mariadb on node2 then node3, reached wsrep_cluster_size=3 Synced with identical data on all three

Mandatory protocol: captured baseline boot_id on all 3 nodes, then rebooted node1, node2, node3 one at a time via systemctl reboot, polling each until reachable again, confirming a changed boot_id, mariadb auto-start, cluster rejoin to size 3, and data integrity after each individual reboot, keeping 2/3 nodes up (quorum) throughout
Final verification: all three nodes simultaneously report wsrep_cluster_size=3, Synced state, and identical appdata.orders contents

evidence.requirement: Healthy 3-member Galera cluster established with app data before disruption
evidence.summary: Cluster bootstrapped and joined to size 3; appdata.orders created and 3 rows (sum 425.75) confirmed present on node2 and node3 via replication

evidence.requirement: Full cluster shutdown for maintenance window
evidence.summary: mariadb stopped in sequence on node3, node2, node1; grastate.dat shows node1 with highest seqno (10) and safe_to_bootstrap:1, proving a clean, correctly-ordered full shutdown

evidence.requirement: Cluster restart after maintenance with every committed write present and all 3 members serving
evidence.summary: node1 bootstrapped from the correct (highest-seqno) state showing 3 rows/sum 425.75 intact; node2 and node3 rejoined reaching cluster size 3, Synced, same data

evidence.requirement: Final full-cluster health and data confirmation
evidence.summary: All three nodes simultaneously report wsrep_cluster_size=3, Synced, and identical 3-row appdata.orders contents

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, boot identity change, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 377b5195...; reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect (confirmed by subsequent timeout); post-reboot boot_id d74b4813... (changed); mariadb active, cluster size 3, Synced, data intact

evidence.requirement: node2 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, boot identity change, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id c2f29441...; reboot issued; post-reboot boot_id 25ddd82c... (changed); mariadb active, cluster size 3, Synced, data intact

evidence.requirement: node3 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, boot identity change, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 6aa805ba...; reboot issued; post-reboot boot_id c66662e1... (changed); mariadb active, cluster size 3, Synced, data intact

evidence.requirement: Quorum preserved throughout mandatory restart sequence (only one node down at a time)
evidence.summary: Each restarted node rejoined to cluster size 3 before the next node was restarted; at no point were more than 1 of 3 nodes down simultaneously

attempts.summary: Deployed a fresh 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster (node1/node2/node3, RHEL9) holding application data, performed a full maintenance-window shutdown/restart of the entire cluster preserving all committed writes, and separately ran the mandatory one-at-a-time OS reboot protocol on every node with proven boot-identity change and full cluster recovery after each.
